description: Find Vargov®Design compositions by the image or shape of their elements — butterflies, stingrays, birds, droplets, leaves, spheres, rings, spirals and more, in any of the site's eight languages — and/or by product type, and/or by element material as confirmed by the brand (ceramic, glass, crystal, metal). Ceramic splits into the same three groups as the page vargov.ru/ceramics: ceramic only; ceramic together with glass or crystal; ceramic or opaque white glass, to choose. Returns LC codes with page links, cover images and the confirmed material, best matches first; the brand's own examples come first. Compositions whose material the brand has not confirmed are never returned by the material filter.

ceramic_group.description: Only with material=ceramic, as on vargov.ru/ceramics: ceramic_only; ceramic_with_glass_or_crystal — ceramic elements together with glass or crystal ones; ceramic_or_glass — ceramic or opaque white glass, to choose.

kind.description: lighting_composition — the catalogue type “Lighting composition” (almost all of them hang from the ceiling); sconce — wall lamps; mirror — mirrors; panel — wall compositions; floor_lamp — the floor and table lamps section, floor art objects included

lang.description: Language of the result: ru, en, de, it, fr, es, vi or ar. Default en.

material.description: Element material confirmed by the brand: ceramic, glass, crystal or metal (metal elements, not a metal frame). A composition matches when its elements include that material, also when the material is one of two to choose from.

motif.description: Image or shape of the elements in any site language: butterflies, бабочки, Schmetterling, stingrays, droplets, spheres…

name: search_compositions
title: Find compositions
